placing.title: How to Place an Order
steps: Browse the catalog or provide your 1688 product links via the quote request form.
Use the Pricing Calculator to review the all-in cost across AED, USD, and SAR, including the transparent 10% platform split.
Confirm your order and make the escrow payment. Your funds are held securely until delivery.
Receive your 7-stage tracking link and follow each milestone — with evidence uploads at inspection, packaging, and shipping.
Scan the delivery QR at the pickup point. Funds are released to the supplier only after you confirm receipt.

milestones.title: Understanding the 7 Order Milestones
milestones.intro: Every BandaChao order moves through seven timestamped stages so you always know precisely where your goods are. Here's what each one means:

stages.name: PENDING
stages.desc: Your order is submitted and being reviewed by the operations team. We verify pricing, stock availability, and supplier score.

stages.name: APPROVED
stages.desc: Order is approved — procurement begins. Escrowed funds are locked but not released to the supplier.

stages.name: PROCURED
stages.desc: Goods have been purchased from the supplier and received at our consolidation warehouse in China.

stages.name: INSPECTED
stages.desc: Independent quality inspection complete. Photos, video, and QC report are attached as evidence.

stages.name: PACKAGED
stages.desc: Goods packaged for export — with branded packaging option, moisture protection, and commercial invoice.

stages.name: SHIPPED
stages.desc: Goods on board the carrier. Air waybill or express tracking is live in the order page.

stages.name: DELIVERED
stages.desc: Goods delivered. Buyer QR scan confirms receipt and triggers fund release to the supplier.

fees.title: Fees & Commissions — 100% Transparent
fees.intro: BandaChao charges a single 10% platform fee on the gross profit of every delivered order. It is split exactly as follows:
rows: Operating share for the founder / operator.
Engineering, platform maintenance, and AI tooling credits.
RAKEZ fees, EmaraTax compliance, and legal counsel.
fees.note: Shipping, cargo insurance, and supplier cost are all passed through at actuals — BandaChao never marks these up. Use the Pricing Calculator to see a full breakdown for any order before you commit.
